note: Both sets capture the same three Energy Balance scoring thresholds with accurate quotes and values. Set A binds them to net electrical energy and keeps the meaningful condition 'at contest conclusion,' which is supported by the text's 'at the conclusion of the specified energy balance period.' Set B instead fills the conditions field with 'Net electrical energy,' which is the measured quantity rather than a condition, so all three of its claims carry a misbound/unsupported condition. Set A is therefore more faithful overall.
